crop.notes: Whole 'Jefferson City' dispatch in 2 pieces; it opens with an unrelated jail-pardon paragraph, then 'A Plea for Tom Allen'.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Judge Chester H. Krum asked Gov. Crittenden to refuse Kentucky's requisition for Tom Allen over an 1876 prize-fighting indictment; the Governor said he was not prepared to honor it.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Thursday, February 21, 1884, page 2. article.json has no focus field.

facts.fact: Allen was indicted in Kentucky in 1876 for prize fighting, a misdemeanor

Judge Chester H. Krum asked Missouri Gov. Crittenden at Jefferson City to refuse to surrender Allen on the requisition of Gov. Knott of Kentucky, arguing the effort was to collect a debt Allen owed to Farrell, the bearer of the requisition
Gov. Crittenden said he was not prepared to honor the Kentucky requisition for Allen, and the paper judged Allen would not be sent to Kentucky
